name: unarchive_task
description: Restore one archived Sunsama task onto a specific day. WRITE - the task returns to the user's Sunsama plan. Use it only when the user asked to bring back that specific archived task; find it first with get_archived_tasks. It is not for tasks in any other app (Asana, Todoist, Jira, a calendar and so on).

taskId.description: The ID of the task to unarchive

calendarDay.description: The date to restore the task to (YYYY-MM-DD format)
